caption:
AI phone agents that book appointments live, mid-call, are rolling out across major CRM platforms this year.

That trend is coming for every service business Black Arrow works with.

A voice bot only pays off if the call reaches a system built to catch it. Most shops still don't have that part built.

This week's test:
Have a friend or family member call your business line during business hours.
Time how long until a human answers or a text goes out.

Past 5 minutes, the lead is cooling.

Fix instant response before you add anything smarter on top of it.

DM TRIAL

#ServiceBusiness #SpeedToLead #MissedCallTextBack #CRMAutomation #HomeServiceMarketing
rationale: Interprets the 2026 rollout of live-call AI appointment booking across CRM platforms, redirecting the hype into an honest priority check on basic speed-to-lead, in the reel format that wins reach for cold-audience news.
